title: GenerationResult
description: P5 final-answer object (p5-answer-v1) consumed by P6. evidence_status=INSUFFICIENT implies empty citations and provenance, and answer equal to the canonical refusal text.

answer.description: The generated answer, or the canonical refusal text. Contains no citation markers; citations live in the citations field.

citations.description: Passage ids. Every id was present in the retrieved context, de-duplicated, in order of first appearance. Empty for a refusal.

evidence_status.description: Whether the retrieved passages supported an answer.

retrieval_rounds.description: Number of retrieval rounds that produced the context. Preserved through a downgrade so retrieval cost stays attributable.

provenance.description: Per-claim evidence map. Empty for a refusal. After a downgrade it is empty too: the model's original claims survive only in the validation report's raw_result, because a refusal makes no claims.
